messages:
zoe: Power blip + router rebooted so i'm working from the balcony under a car bonnet (long story). hammock chair + hoodie = surprisingly good acoustics. photo incoming.
hank: car bonnet? you mean like a little shade shelter? pics pls :camera_with_flash:
zoe: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-F20001/bonnet-balcony.jpg (yes the bonnet is propped to make a mini awning)
maya: This is a level of ingenuity i respect. how's the hotspot performance?
zoe: tethered phone in airplane mode w/ hotspot: ~25ms to local region, 20 Mbps down, 5 up. video ok if i keep camera off.
hank: pro tip: clip a cooling pack under the laptop if it's baking in the sun, saved my SSD once.
infra-bot: Reminder: do not bridge personal network devices to corporate VLANs. If you need help with secure access over personal hotspots, request a temporary infra VPN endpoint.
zoe: not bridging anything, just SSH and our VPN. adding bonnet photo to the WFH gallery. TL;DR: balcony + bonnet = mobile shade office, bring sunscreen and a clamp.
